page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing and large-scale deep learning pipelines. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this host provides 54 dedicated vCPUs paired with 480 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 8.89 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration emphasizes multi-processor compute throughput, ensuring adequate host resources to feed intensive parallel workloads.

Acceleration is driven by eight integrated NVIDIA Pascal-generation P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 128 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM (16 GB per GPU). For local scratch space, caching, and data pipelines, the instance includes 3779 GB of integrated local SSD storage, mitigating potential data ingest bottlenecks during model checkpointing or training cycles. Network connectivity is supported by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth, though the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual private cloud routing or secondary network allocation for external access.

From an architectural efficiency perspective, the provision of eight discrete accelerators alongside significant onboard SSD capacity makes the instance effective for legacy CUDA applications and distributed deep learning jobs that do not require newer tensor-core architectures. While the Pascal-generation P100 lacks modern mixed-precision execution units present in newer accelerators, the substantial aggregate VRAM and local storage density provide a reliable platform for scientific simulations, molecular dynamics, distributed machine learning inference, and complex batch image processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated instance tailored for highly parallelized workloads and deep learning tasks. The configuration features 54 dedicated vCPUs, 480 GB of memory (8.89 GB per vCPU), and a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor. Hardware acceleration is provided by eight discrete NVIDIA P100 GPUs delivering 128 GB of combined VRAM, supported by 3779 GB of high-speed local SSD storage. The combination of dedicated compute resources, eight-way GPU distribution, and substantial local disk space provides an effective foundation for compute-heavy pipelines, data processing clusters, scientific simulation modeling, and large-scale model training environments requiring substantial local scratch space.
